requirement: Annual modern slavery statement; contracts should oblige suppliers to prevent modern slavery
penalty: High Court injunction (unlimited fine for contempt); public-sector exclusion and reputational risk

requirement: Products made with forced labour banned from the EU market; suppliers must give traceability data on request
penalty: Products withdrawn and disposed of at our cost; fines set by member states

requirement: Goods made with forced labour barred from import; importer must trace inputs through sub-suppliers
penalty: Customs detention, seizure and exclusion of goods

requirement: Identify and prevent human rights and environmental harms; obtain contractual assurances from suppliers
penalty: Fines of at least 5% of net worldwide turnover; civil liability to victims

requirement: Risk analysis, grievance mechanism and audit rights across direct suppliers
penalty: Fines up to EUR 8m or 2% of annual turnover; up to 3 years excluded from public tenders

requirement: Strict liability for defective products; cannot be excluded towards consumers; supplier cap must carve out injury
penalty: Strict liability; unlimited damages for death and personal injury

requirement: Strict liability for defective products incl. software; contract caps do not bind injured persons
penalty: Strict liability; compensation for death and personal injury not capped

requirement: Producers and distributors must notify unsafe products and run recalls; recall costs should be recoverable from the supplier
penalty: Criminal offence: up to 12 months imprisonment and/or unlimited fine

regulation: State product liability law (strict liability tort)
requirement: Retailers in the chain of sale are liable to injured users; supplier must carry insurance and indemnify
penalty: Compensatory and punitive damages; class actions
